description: BC-only ontology projection: one full GET-only capture pass of every pinned BC Production company into a throwaway capture store, its projection alone (source bc, no Portal mirror) under the curated schema into a throwaway store, then plx.around (every link type with a bc.purchase_orders end), plx.timeline and plx.process (purchase_to_invoice: the three-way match) from up to 20 BC-rooted purchase orders as a full-grant reader. Pass = every answer matches its frozen contract, every citation is a bc:// capture handle, a hop toward a Portal binding never answers absent_in_source (Portal is not captured: not_ingested or unknown), no link at corroborated or above joins two BC companies, and the three-way match decides some comparison unless every undecided one names a missing-source reason (three_way.explained). Output is counts, booleans and gap/stage states only; never a value, number, name or citation. live-unverified until a live result exists.
notes: Its only requires is its session producer bc.capture_full, which never blocks it: BC is captured and projected independently of the Portal, so a Portal outage never skips this check. Session state (verify/live_verify.py): its capture audience (business-central, the BC service credentials, service reader: integrations.bc_read.capture_probe's own service audience over CAPTURE_ENTITY_SETS) is bc.capture_full's, so it tops up that producer's {session_state}/bc-capture.sqlite when the producer filled it in the session (capture_topped_up true, capture_units_reused: only units the session completed, PLX_CAPTURE_FRESH_SINCE from the runner, are not read again; a store from an earlier invocation is read again; capture_age_seconds is the oldest complete unit's age; session_state.shared_store, producer_verdict), else captures cold. Daily: one full capture pass reads every pinned company's 21 units (document lines cost one GET per header; live bc.capture_full needed more than 700 s per pass), so the capture gets 75% of the 2,400 s budget (1,800 s) and the build and tool checks the rest. A capture that does not finish is still projected; its units are counted in bc_incomplete_bindings (source_capture_incomplete) and every answer stays undecided rather than absent, so units_complete and all_complete are recorded, not required. three_way records decided/undecided comparisons and undecided_by: each undecided comparison counted by the one typed code that holds it back (scripts/ontology_projection_bc_probe.py undecided_code). A BC side read from its own complete BC records is decided past the uncaptured Portal twin (cross_system_unchecked, docs/decisions/2026-10-05-bc-only-portal-hops.md); the missing-source codes (an unfinished or unread BC unit, a stage with no record yet, a draft PO) are the expected BC-only shape and bc_incomplete_by_binding names the unfinished bindings. Any other code with nothing decided fails three_way.explained. Module tests: injected-transport (ontology/tests/test_project_bc.py runs this probe over an in-process BC fake). Live-unverified until the live check records a result.
